assessment: This important study reports a previously undocumented role for ubiquitin-proteasome system (UPS)-mediated protein turnover in size control in human cells. The authors show that large cells undergo size compensation by actively reducing their rate of growth and this effect is shown to be mediated by an increase in the rate of proteasome-mediated degradation. The experiments are well controlled, and the conclusions of the study are compelling and well supported by the data. Overall the paper increases our knowledge related to size control mechanisms in dividing and non-dividing cells.
